title: Rental Owner Increment to the Direct Card Limit
content:
**Rule.** The rental owner increment raises the direct card limit on a Real Estate Service Contracts buyer-only order for a buyer who holds a Bridgewell Rental Property Service Contracts contract in status active, according to the rental premium payments recorded for the buyer in the twelve months before the payment date.

| Buyer holds an active Rental Property Service Contracts contract | Rental premium payments in the twelve months before the payment date | Rental owner increment |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 24 or more | $150.00 |
| yes | 12 or more but fewer than 24 | $75.00 |
| yes | fewer than 12 | nothing |
| no | any | nothing |

It is added once to the direct card limit, before the card payments already taken on the order are deducted from the limit and the limit is floored at zero.

## Records read

From the Rental Property Service Contracts records: whether the buyer holds a contract in status active, and the premium payments recorded for the buyer with their dates.

## Boundaries (hypothetical buyers with an active rental contract)

| Rental premium payments in the window | Increment |
|---|---|
| 11 | nothing |
| 12 | $75.00 |
| 23 | $75.00 |
| 24 | $150.00 |
